extensions.evidence: Torium protocol v1 defines the same-byte 0x/Bech32 contract and validates four bidirectional address vectors independently produced with the exact upstream evmd debug addr command.
Torium trust model v1 consumes the exact CometBFT finality contract, distinguishes authority stages from decentralization, and assigns stable fault-test IDs without upgrading any untested capability.

Torium threat model v1 maps every high/critical chain, contract, RPC, operator, artifact, and recovery risk to prevention, detection, recovery, owners, executable test IDs, residual risk, and blocking public-release gates without upgrading untested compatibility claims.

Canonical Torium localnet conformance deploys and mutates unmodified OpenZeppelin ERC-20/ERC-721 contracts with pinned clients, executes a 64-case Ethereum state-test subset against the exact Cosmos go-ethereum replacement, proves transaction types 0/1/2, rejects wrong-chain and unprotected signatures, and records fee-history, replacement, nonce-gap, capacity, RPC, and gas-estimation boundaries.

baseline.identifierConstraint: EIP-155 ID 262144 is registered to MPCQ Mainnet. Preserve it only in historical #89 evidence; canonical Torium IDs come from chain/config/identifiers.json.

capabilities.evidence: Four validators produced blocks and recovered after a validator restart.
All 64 selected Cancun and Prague cases from 13 byte-pinned ethereum/tests v16.0 fixtures pass against github.com/cosmos/go-ethereum v1.17.2-cosmos-0 with zero runtime skips.
Canonical localnet accepted EIP-155 protected legacy type 0, EIP-2930 type 1, and EIP-1559 type 2 transactions and returned receipt types 0x0, 0x1, and 0x2.

Canonical localnet immediately rejected blob type 3 and did not retain or propose set-code type 4 after its asynchronous RPC acknowledgement; the Torium ante policy independently rejects both before ordinary EVM handling.
capabilities.constraint: Torium has no blob data-availability market and does not enable EIP-7702 delegated code; clients must reject both envelope types instead of downgrading or emulating them.

capabilities.evidence: Canonical localnet rejected a legacy transaction signed for EIP-155 chain ID 1414484557 and rejected a Homestead-style unprotected legacy transaction while leaving the sender nonce unchanged.
A locally signed EIP-1559 transfer changed the recipient balance by exactly 1 wei.

Canonical Torium localnet returned exactly 100 entries at the configured cap, rejected 101 with JSON-RPC -32000, and reported gasUsedRatio 1 plus linked current/next base fees for a block that used all 30,000,000 configured gas.
capabilities.constraint: The method has a non-geth 100-block user cap that SDK fee estimation must preserve and surface.

capabilities.constraint: SDK and tooling integrations must expose the raw estimate and use a documented configurable contract-call gas margin until the Cosmos EVM estimator matches committed execution.

capabilities.evidence: On canonical localnet with consensus halted, a 9% bump was rejected and an exact 10% bump of both fee cap and tip cap replaced the transaction on the receiving validator.
capabilities.constraint: The replacement was not observed on the peer while consensus was halted; no network-wide RBF guarantee is allowed.

capabilities.evidence: On canonical localnet, nonce N+2 was admitted before N+1 without changing committed or pending nonce; both committed in nonce order after the gap was filled and quorum resumed.

capabilities.constraint: RPC acceptance is not a retention guarantee and the exact boundary is not observable from the default endpoint; SDK lifecycle APIs must surface dropped/replaced/unknown outcomes.
